subject: Provisional headroom smoothing request and post-launch burst reconciliation
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@scalebox.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: h.kumar@scalebox.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-launch burst reconciliation + provisional credit request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding help — launch went mostly smoothly but we spiked considerably on May 3 between 03:10-04:00 UTC. Our engineering dashboard shows ~7.8M tokens above our committed monthly baseline for that hour (attached export). That surge pushed us into overrun territory and our platform is flagging a large unexpected invoice.

Given this was an early-traffic stabilization period tied to a marketing pop and not representative of steady-state traffic, can Redwood provide a one-time provisional headroom smoothing or a blended overrun rate for May while we implement client-side rate flattening? Ideally we would prefer a credit applied to the May invoice rather than a refund.

We attached a small worksheet (burst-recon-worksheet.xlsx) with the hourly counts. Harris and I are available all day Friday for a quick call to align.

Appreciate any short-term relief you can offer while we finalize our plan to cap token usage.

—Olivia Park
Ops Lead, ScaleBox Inc

Attachment(s): burst-recon-worksheet.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia@scalebox.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-launch burst reconciliation + provisional credit request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the worksheet. I pulled the same metrics and can see the single-hour spike you referenced.

Short answer: we can propose a one-time smoothing arrangement to reduce the immediate billing impact, and gate it on a short mutual action plan so this doesn’t repeat. Recommended next steps from our side:
- Provisionally apply a blended overrun rate for the May invoice for the excess tokens tied to the launch window (we’ll propose a number below).
- Create a 30-day remediation plan with ScaleBox to add client-side rate caps and slow-start ramps.
- Execute a short addendum (billing credit + updated invoicing mechanics) signed by both sides.

Ben — can you confirm the blended rate we can offer for this single incident and whether Finance prefers a credit line item vs. invoice adjustment? Marissa — can you prepare an addendum template and a concise AM/PM timeline we can send to ScaleBox?

Olivia/Harris — are you available for a 30-min alignment call Friday at 10:00am PT? If not, propose a window and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Olivia Park <olivia@scalebox.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-launch burst reconciliation + provisional credit request

Thanks — quick read from Sales: we can offer a one-time blended overrun rate for the excess tokens tied specifically to the May 3 launch window. Proposed commercial mechanics:

Option A (preferred):
- Apply a provisional credit equivalent to charging the excess usage at 50% of the standard overrun rate for the May invoice.
- Credit shows as a line item on the May invoice; no cash refund.
- ScaleBox signs a short addendum acknowledging remediation timelines (rate caps, prefetched KV caches, or token sampling) to avoid repeat events.

Option B (if Finance objects):
- Apply a delayed invoice adj: create a negative invoice for the credit applied against the June invoice.

I’m estimating provisional credit ~$4,800 based on the worksheet numbers. This is contingent on Finance sign-off and a signed addendum.

Olivia — if you’re good with Option A, Priya/Marissa/Neha — let’s fast-track the doc and get signatures.

—Ben
Director, Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): provisional-credit-term.pdf (PDF summary of proposed term)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@scalebox.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-launch burst reconciliation + provisional credit request

Circling from Finance. Option A is acceptable with conditions:
1) We need a signed addendum stating the effective date and the exact credit calculation method (hours, token counts, blended rate).
2) Accounting requires the credit be applied as a contra-revenue line on May’s invoice; we cannot issue a cash refund.
3) For audit and SOX purposes, please include the HubSpot deal id and the procurement PO number in the addendum.
4) We need to cap the liability: the addendum should explicitly limit the credit to the May 3 spike and not establish precedent for future months.

If ScaleBox is ready to sign an addendum, we can approve the ~$4.8k credit and have it reflected on the May invoice. Otherwise we’ll route to delayed adj on June as Ben noted.

I’ve added the HubSpot record for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721

—Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-launch burst reconciliation + provisional credit request

Olivia/Harris — thanks for taking the call this morning. To summarize and set immediate next steps so we’re all aligned:

1) Redwood will extend Option A: apply a one-time credit for the May 3 spike equal to charging the excess at 50% of our standard overrun rate (~$4,800). This will appear as a contra-revenue line on the May invoice.

2) The credit is expressly limited to the May 3 03:10-04:00 UTC window and to the token counts in the attached worksheet. No precedent implied beyond this incident.

3) Action items:
- Marissa: please attach the addendum draft (signed-addendum-draft.docx) and the provisional-credit-term.pdf to the HubSpot deal, and prepare a DocuSign envelope for ScaleBox. (Due: EOD Friday)
- Olivia/Harris: sign the addendum via DocuSign and return the PO number for accounting. (Target: Monday)
- Neha: once signed addendum is received, apply the contra-revenue credit to May invoice and close the ticket.

Olivia — if that reads correctly, I’ll share the DocuSign link and the addendum. Thanks again for the clear worksheet; that sped the review.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
